profile.name: Jeremy Lim
profile.bio:
I am Jeremy Lim, an undergraduate at International Christian University in Tokyo, studying Linguistics and Information Science. My academic interests center on computational linguistics, speech science, and low-resource language research, especially Southern Min (Hokkien).

Beyond research, I am involved in photography, writing, and interdisciplinary collaboration. I am interested in how faith, technology, and human dignity interact in the age of AI.

articles.title: Research Demo: Phonological Cognition Study (HISPhonCog 2026)
articles.excerpt: A demo and supplementary materials for my paper submitted to HIS PhonCog 2026. The research explores phonological cognition in Southern Min (Hokkien) using computational methods.
articles.content:
A demo and supplementary materials for my paper submitted to HIS PhonCog 2026 (Paper #141).

The research explores phonological cognition in Southern Min (Hokkien) using computational methods.

Full demo and code: https://github.com/ICU-JeremyLim/HISPhonCog2026Paper141
